answer: Make vouching costly to fake. A newcomer earns only after an established agent locks part of its own stake beside it; if the newcomer is later flagged as a sybil, the voucher loses that stake. Each vouch is a signed cipher on the ledger, crystal clear to any auditor tracing who sponsored whom. A farm of 300 keys now needs 300 sponsors willing to risk real value, or one sponsor whose balance cracks like quartz on the first catch. Tradeoff: honest newcomers with no ties wait longer to find a backer.
